description:
OEDRO Performance Floor Mats Use the Latest 3D Laser Scanning Technology. Our New Floor Liner Design Perfectly Fits Your Footwell
Our R&D team works tirelessly to ensure that our customers are satisfied. We continuously strive to provide high-quality products and services to our fellow off-road vehicle and truck owners. As off-road experts, we at OEDRO believe first and foremost in providing excellent quality, dedicated service, affordable prices, and outstanding designs.
Features
Durability. One of the best things about OEDRO floor mats is that they are developed with strong rubber. This gives them longevity in comparison to other styles of mats. The floor mats are quite flexible. The heavy-duty material is also capable of withstanding constant rubbing and contacting of shoes.
Excellent Visual Appearance. By adding an all-weather floor liner to your car’s interior, you will add color and class to your car. The mat’s unique appearance will accentuate the interior look of your car tenfold.
Protecting the Interior. OEDRO Floor mats offer vehicles perhaps the most comprehensive interior protection in comparison to any other car mat. Your car’s carpet will remain clean and dry at all times.
Cleaning these Mats is Quite Easy. The materials used for creating floor mats are extremely simple to wash and clean. You can easily wash and clean the spillage on top of it. You can also spray it using soap and water. Also, there won’t be any odor remaining once the mat dries out.
It Traps Dirt and Moisture. The waterproof surface of all-weather floor mats makes sure to trap any kind of spillage on top of it. The mats can also trap dust, sand, and other dry particles effectively.
2 years warranty. For your safety, professional installation is highly recommended.
Fitment
Compatible with 2016-2017 Subaru Crosstrek
Compatible with 2012-2016 Subaru Impreza
Compatible with 2015-2020 Subaru WRX/WRX STI
Compatible with 2013-2015 Subaru XV Crosstrek
highlights: Premium Interior Protection: OEDRO Floor mats trap dirt, debris, and liquids to keep your vehicle floor clean and protected.
Secure Driving Confidence: Anti-slip texture keeps mats firmly in place, helping ensure a safer and more stable ride.
Built to Last: Durable, recyclable Thermoplastic Elastomer construction delivers long-term protection with easy maintenance
